title: Consultant | Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing (VAPT) | Chennai | Cyber Defense & Resil
description:
**Your potential, unleashed.**

  

India’s impact on the global economy has increased at an exponential rate and Deloitte presents an opportunity to unleash and realize your potential amongst cutting edge leaders, and organizations shaping the future of the region, and indeed, the world beyond.

  

At Deloitte, your whole self to work, every day. Combine that with our drive to propel with purpose and you have the perfect playground to collaborate, innovate, grow, and make an impact that matters.

  

**The Team**

Deloitte helps organizations prevent cyberattacks and protect valuable assets. We believe in being secure, vigilant, and resilient—not only by looking at how to prevent and respond to attacks, but at how to manage cyber risk in a way that allows you to unleash new opportunities. Embed cyber risk at the start of strategy development for more effective management of information and technology risks

  

**Your work profile**

  

We are looking for Security Engineer at **Consultant** level in our **Cyber** Team. As part of your work profile, you’ll build and nurture positive working relationships with teams and clients with the intention to exceed client expectations: -

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Total 2-4 years of experience in Cyber security domain

* Understanding of basic business and information technology management processes.

* Good knowledge of TCP/ IP and Networks including Firewall, IDS/IPS, Routers, Switches, and network architecture.

* Experience of **Web Application Security Testing, Infrastructure VAPT, API testing**.

* Basic understanding of **AI/LLM concepts, Generative AI applications,** and common AI application architectures.

* Knowledge of AI security testing methodologies, including Prompt Injection, Jailbreak Testing, sensitive data exposure, and system prompt leakage.

* Ability to assist in AI penetration testing of LLM-based applications, chatbots, and RAG-based solutions under defined testing methodologies.

* Familiarity with AI security testing tools, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, and basic AI guardrail validation techniques. Relevant AI Security or AI Penetration Testing certifications would be an added advantage.

* Experience on **Mobile Security Pen-Testing (iOS and Android)**.

* Experience in conducting **Configuration reviews of Servers, Network devices, Windows, Linux, UNIX, Solaris, Databases, etc**.

* Experience with Vulnerability Management and Penetration testing tools: Burp suite, Kali Linux, Acunetix, AppScan, Nexpose, Qualys Guard, Nessus, Nmap, Metasploit, Fortify etc.

* Experience in basic scripting such as: Shell, Python, PERL, etc.

* Basic knowledge of Technoilogies such as: IPSEC, SSL, SSH, VPN, Ethernet Token Ring, WAP, SMTP, FTP, Frame Relay, WAN, ATM, FDDI, DSL, ISDN, HP Openview, Sun NetManage, Cisco Works, Radius, Big Brother, F5.

  

**Additional Skills**

* Experience on **End Point Security, Threat Profiling, Configuration Review**

* Experience on **Firewall and Network Devices Configuration Review**.

* Strong analytical and communication skills (written, verbal and presentation)

* Open to learn new tools and technologies as per the project requirement

* Interactive with team members and confident during client meetings, under the guidance of senior members of the project

* Initiative & drive

* Be deadline-oriented and quality-focused

* Familiarity with industry standards and frameworks such as OWASP, CIS, NIST ISO/IEC 17799, etc.

* Demonstrates basic knowledge of security and privacy controls and risk management processes

* Demonstrates basic knowledge in one or more Cyber Threat Management domains such as: Threat Management, Cyber Operations/Fusion Managed Services, Malware Analysis, Collective Threat Intelligence and Cyber Risk Sciences, Incident Management and Forensics, Data Protection solutions.

  

**Desired qualifications**

* B.Tech/M.Tech

* Candidates must possess security certification of CEH, OSCP, CRTP, eJPT, CRTA.

* AI Pen testing Certification.

* Good to have security certification for GPEN, CREST

  

**Location and way of working**

* Base location: Chennai

  

**Your role as Leader**

  

We expect our people to embrace and live our purpose by challenging themselves to identify issues that are most important for our clients, our people, and for society.

  

In addition to living our purpose, Senior Executive across our organization must strive to be:

  

* Inspiring - Leading with integrity to build inclusion and motivation

* Committed to creating purpose - Creating a sense of vision and purpose

* Agile - Achieving high-quality results through collaboration and Team unity

* Skilled at building diverse capability - Developing diverse capabilities for the future

* Persuasive / Influencing - Persuading and influencing stakeholders

* Collaborating - Partnering to build new solutions

* Delivering value - Showing commercial acumen

* Committed to expanding business - Leveraging new business opportunities

* Analytical Acumen - Leveraging data to recommend impactful approach and solutions through the power of analysis and visualization

* Effective communication – Must be well abled to have well-structured and well-articulated conversations to achieve win-win possibilities

* Engagement Management / Delivery Excellence - Effectively managing engagement(s) to ensure timely and proactive execution as well as course correction for the success of engagement(s)

* Managing change - Responding to changing environment with resilience

* Managing Quality & Risk - Delivering high quality results and mitigating risks with utmost integrity and precision

* Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving - Applying strategic mindset to solve business issues and complex problems

* Tech Savvy - Leveraging ethical technology practices to deliver high impact for clients and for Deloitte

* Empathetic leadership and inclusivity - creating a safe and thriving environment where everyone's valued for who they are, use empathy to understand others to adapt our behaviours and attitudes to become more inclusive.

  

**How you’ll grow**

  

***Connect for impact***

  

Our exceptional team of professionals across the globe are solving some of the world’s most complex business problems, as well as directly supporting our communities, the planet, and each other. Know more in our Global Impact Report and our India Impact Report.

  

***Empower to lead***

  

You can be a leader irrespective of your career level. Our colleagues are characterised by their ability to inspire, support, and provide opportunities for people to deliver their best and grow both as professionals and human beings. Know more about Deloitte and our One Young World partnership.

  

***Inclusion for all***

  

At Deloitte, people are valued and respected for who they are and are trusted to add value to their clients, teams and communities in a way that reflects their own unique capabilities. Know more about everyday steps that you can take to be more inclusive. At Deloitte, we believe in the unique skills, attitude and potential each and every one of us brings to the table to make an impact that matters.

  

***Drive your career***

  

At Deloitte, you are encouraged to take ownership of your career. We recognise there is no one size fits all career path, and global, cross-business mobility and up / re-skilling are all within the range of possibilities to shape a unique and fulfilling career. Know more about Life at Deloitte.

  

**Everyone’s welcome… entrust your happiness to us**

Our workspaces and initiatives are geared towards your 360-degree happiness. This includes specific needs you may have in terms of accessibility, flexibility, safety and security, and caregiving. Here’s a glimpse of things that are in store for you.

  

**Interview tips**

  

We want job seekers exploring opportunities at Deloitte to feel prepared, confident and comfortable. To help you with your interview, we suggest that you do your research, know some background about the organization and the business area you’re applying to. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte professionals.

  

\*Caution against fraudulent job offers\*: We would like to advise career aspirants to exercise caution against fraudulent job offers or unscrupulous practices.

At Deloitte, ethics and integrity are fundamental and not negotiable. We do not charge any fee or seek any deposits, advance, or money from any career aspirant in relation to our recruitment process. We have not authorized any party or person to collect any money from career aspirants in any form whatsoever for promises of getting jobs in Deloitte or for being considered against roles in Deloitte. We follow a professional recruitment process, provide a fair opportunity to eligible applicants and consider candidates only on merit. No one other than an authorized official of

  

Deloitte is permitted to offer or confirm any job offer from Deloitte. We advise career aspirants to exercise caution.

In this regard, you may refer to a more detailed advisory given on our website at: https://www2.deloitte.com/in/en/careers/advisory-for-career-aspirants.html?icid=wn\_

title: Red Team Engineer – Offensive Security / Advanced VAPT (5+ Years)
description:
**Job Description – Red Team Engineer**

Company: BriskInfosec Technology and Consulting Pvt. Ltd.

Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu

Work Mode: Work from Office (On-site)

Experience: 5+ Years

Employment Type: Full-time

CTC: As per competence and industry standards

Travel: Domestic and International (as required)

**About BriskInfosec**

BriskInfosec Technology and Consulting Pvt. Ltd. has been delivering cybersecurity services

since 2017, serving clients across 30+ countries. Our clientele spans OEMs, Banking and

Financial Services (BFSI), SaaS, Healthcare, and Trading industries.

We are looking for an experienced Red Team Engineer with strong hands-on offensive

security expertise, a research-driven mindset, and the ability to execute advanced red team

and adversary simulation engagements beyond traditional checklist-based VAPT.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan, execute, and lead end-to-end red team and adversary simulation engagements,

from reconnaissance to final reporting.

* Identify and exploit complex attack paths across Web Applications, APIs, Cloud,

Networks, Active Directory, and Mobile platforms.

* Develop Proof of Concept (PoC) exploits, custom scripts, and tools for authorised

security engagements.

* Conduct research on emerging attack techniques, AI-driven offensive security, and

vulnerabilities in AI/LLM-based systems.

* Translate security research and emerging threat intelligence into practical testing

methodologies.

* Execute highly confidential security engagements while maintaining strict discretion

and professionalism.

* Present technical findings and actionable recommendations to clients, including

technical teams and senior leadership.

* Prepare detailed security assessment reports with reproducible steps, supporting

evidence, and remediation guidance.

* Mentor junior security engineers and contribute to strengthening the organisation's

red teaming capabilities.

* Manage multiple engagements simultaneously while ensuring quality, priorities, and

delivery timelines.

* Travel to domestic and international client locations as required.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in Offensive Security, VAPT, and Red

Teaming.

* Strong practical experience in planning and executing red team engagements and

adversary simulations.

* Experience working with at least two of the following industry domains:

o Banking and Financial Services (BFSI)

o OEM

o SaaS

o Healthcare

o Trading

* Strong understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework, red team methodologies,

and Command and Control (C2) tools.

* Proficiency in scripting and programming languages such as Python, Go, C, or similar.

* Experience in exploit development, attack simulation, and custom security tool

development.

* Demonstrable technical contributions through any one of the following:

o Bug bounty Hall of Fame recognition

o CVE publications

o CTF achievements

o Open-source security tools

o Technical research or security write-ups

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex

attack scenarios to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

* Strong technical documentation and report-writing skills.

* Ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and handle high-pressure client

engagements.

* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and a continuous learning

mindset.

* High ethical standards, with a strong commitment to engagement scope, client data

protection, and confidentiality.

* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.

Good to Have

* Industry-recognised offensive security certifications such as:

o OSCP

o OSEP

o CRTO

o CRTP / CRTE

o OSED

* Experience conducting red team engagements in regulated environments.

* Experience in AI/LLM security testing and emerging offensive security research.

* Security conference presentations, published research, technical blogs, or

community contributions.

**What We Offer**

* Exposure to global cybersecurity engagements across clients in 30+ countries.

* Opportunities for domestic and international client visits.

* Dedicated support and opportunities for Research and Development (R&D).

* Exposure to diverse industries, technologies, and advanced attack surfaces.

* Opportunities to explore emerging offensive security techniques and tools.

* The opportunity to contribute to and shape BriskInfosec's Red Team and Offensive

Security practice.

* Competitive compensation based on skills, experience, and industry standards.

**Work Location:**

This is an on-site position based in Chennai, Tamil Nadu. Candidates currently based in

Chennai or willing to relocate are preferred.

The role requires close collaboration with the offensive security team, particularly for attack

path planning, technical discussions, knowledge sharing, and mentoring.

Join BriskInfosec and help shape the next generation of offensive security.

Pay: From ₹40,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Web Application
description:
**Job Title:** Web Application VAPT Tester

**Experience:** Fresher / 0–1 Year (Bug Bounty Experience Mandatory)

**Salary:** ₹18,000 – ₹20,000 per month

**Location:** Chennai (On-site)

**Joining:** Immediate

**Job Description:**

We are looking for a passionate **Web Application VAPT Tester** to join our team . Candidates with strong interest in web security and hands-on bug bounty experience are encouraged to apply.

· Perform **Web Application Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT)**

* Familiarity with mobile application security testing methodologies

* Relevant certifications such as CEH, eJPT, PNPT, OSCP, Security+, or similar

Eligibility

Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity / Information Technology / Computer Science or related field

Minimum 3 years of relevant cybersecurity or VAPT experience

Strong passion for application security and ethical hacking

Experience:

* in API Testing: 1 year (Preferred)
* in Web application testing: 1 year (Preferred)
* in mobile application testing: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

Pay: ₹216,000.00 - ₹300,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

title: Software Security Master
description:
**Join our Team**
-----------------

**About this opportunity:**  
We are looking for a Software Security Master, a senior technical specialist responsible for enabling end-to-end software security across the development lifecycle.  
You will act as a security subject-matter expert for engineering teams, embedding security by design across architecture, development, testing, CI/CD, release, deployment, and operations. The role combines hands-on security engineering with threat modeling, vulnerability management, DevSecOps, risk management, security testing, and coaching.

**What you will do:**  
Drive security by design throughout the software development lifecycle.  
Conduct security and privacy risk assessments and threat modeling for products and features.  
Identify security risks, attack surfaces, sensitive data, trust boundaries, and required security controls.  
Translate identified risks into security requirements, mitigations, and verification activities.  
Promote secure coding, least privilege, defense in depth, secure authentication and authorization, and data protection practices.  
Perform or coordinate security design reviews, secure code reviews, and root-cause analysis of security issues.  
Integrate automated security controls into CI/CD pipelines, including SAST, DAST, SCA, vulnerability scanning, and secrets detection.  
Analyse CVEs and vulnerabilities affecting applications, platforms, containers, cloud services, operating systems, and third-party dependencies.  
Assess vulnerability severity, exploitability, impact, remediation actions, and target resolution dates.  
Coordinate remediation of critical and high-severity security findings and support risk acceptance where required.  
Plan and review penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, and security verification activities.  
Ensure security risks, test results, remediation actions, and release evidence are properly documented and traceable.  
Provide security guidance for release readiness, deployment, and post-release activities.  
Coach developers, architects, testers, DevOps, SRE, and operations teams on secure development practices.  
Promote security awareness and knowledge sharing across engineering teams.  
Collaborate with product, engineering, architecture, privacy, legal, compliance, operations, and security stakeholders.

**The skills you bring:**  
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, Information Security, or equivalent experience.  
Strong professional experience in Software Security, Product Security, Application Security, Secure Software Development, or DevSecOps.  
Hands-on experience with threat modeling, security risk assessments, secure coding, code reviews, vulnerability analysis, and security testing.  
Experience analysing CVEs and security findings across applications, operating systems, containers, cloud platforms, and third-party dependencies.  
Strong understanding of vulnerability remediation, mitigation, dependency management, and risk acceptance.  
Experience integrating security controls into CI/CD pipelines.  
Knowledge of SAST, DAST, SCA, vulnerability scanning, secrets detection, and penetration testing.  
Understanding of APIs, distributed systems, IAM, network security, cryptography, and data protection.  
Experience with Kubernetes, containers, Cloud Native technologies, Infrastructure as Code, and security automation is preferred.  
Familiarity with security standards and frameworks such as OWASP, CWE/SANS Top 25, NIST, and ISO 27001.  
Experience in telecommunications, cloud-native platforms, distributed systems, or complex software environments would be advantageous.  
Strong analytical and risk-based decision-making skills.  
Certifications such as CISSP, CSSLP, OSCP, or GIAC would be an added advantage.

**Why join Ericsson?**At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.  
  
**What happens once you apply?**Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

title: Junior Penetration Tester - Urapakkam (Near Kilambakkam / Vandalur)
description:

Bug bounty program participations

OWASP top 10 vulnerabilities  
Report Writing

Nessus  
Burp Suite  
SQL Map  
Nikto
